name: omadia-dev-platform
description: The Omadia Dev Platform, extracted from omadia core as an installable plugin (epic byte5ai/omadia#470).
//typecheck: packages/plugin resolves @omadia/dev-platform-plugin-api through its emitted .d.ts, so the API package is BUILT before anything is type-checked. You cannot type-check against declarations that do not exist yet.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/plugin-api && npm run build -w packages/plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/plugin-api && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present

//esbuild: The sibling plugin repos pin ^0.24.0; this one does not. esbuild <=0.24.2 carries GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (the dev server answers cross-origin requests), and a brand-new public repo should not ship with a known advisory. We only ever call the build() API from scripts/test.mjs — never serve() — so the advisory does not reach us either way, but the fix is free.
